# RallyOnly

> RallyOnly automatically trims tennis, padel and pickleball match recordings. It detects rallies, removes downtime and creates highlight reels on the device. No account or video upload is required.

What it gives you from one recording:

- A condensed match based on the detected rallies. Unsaved cuts may depend on the original video.
- A short highlight reel of the best rallies, picked automatically.
- Detected rallies ranked, so you can tick the ones you want and build your own reel; serves get their own list.
- Match scoreboard: switch any rally to Score mode and tap who won each point (or start from any rally with Set score); Pro exports overlay the scoreboard on the video.
- Frame-by-frame wheel on the right of the video to step through any stroke one frame at a time.
- Exports in 16:9 (YouTube), 9:16 (stories, Reels, TikTok) or 1:1 — as one video or one file per rally. Any rally's start and end can be nudged.

Facts:

- Platform: iPhone (iOS 17 or later), iPad, and Apple silicon Mac with a shared Pro subscription (since version 1.40). No Android version. See the App Store for availability.
- Price: free for four new matches a month with every feature (free exports carry a small watermark). RallyOnly Pro removes the limit and the watermark: €5.99/month or €44.99/year (US$5.99/month or US$44.99/year in the US App Store; exact local price shown in the App Store); new subscribers can start with a free trial. Prices differ by country.
- Analysis time varies with the device and recording.
- Privacy and storage: analysis runs locally on the device; RallyOnly does not upload recordings and reads directly from Photos without copying multi-gigabyte videos into app storage.
- It does not record video itself, and it does not do line calls, ball speed or shot statistics.
- Import from Photos, Files, or local file selection on Mac.
- Languages: English, Spanish, German, French, Italian, Simplified Chinese.
- Compared with SwingVision: SwingVision also does line calls, ball speed, stats and in-app recording, and costs more (from US$14.99/month). RallyOnly does only the part that removes the time between points. RallyOnly is independent and not affiliated with SwingVision, Inc.
